AccountSummary.description: The Account page header + overview. Metrics reuse the Scout computations.
AccountSummary.title: AccountSummary

AgentApprovalPrepareRequest.description:
Step 1 of sign-with-wallet. The browser generated the agent keypair; it sends only
the agent ADDRESS here and gets back the exact EIP-712 typed data to sign.
AgentApprovalPrepareRequest.title: AgentApprovalPrepareRequest

AgentApprovalSubmitRequest.description: Step 2: the signed approval plus the agent private key (generated in the browser).
AgentApprovalSubmitRequest.title: AgentApprovalSubmitRequest

CloseAllResponse.description:
POST /api/engine/close-all. `settings` has `enabled` false already;
the closes themselves happen on the engine's next cycle (watch
/api/events for `close` events with reason "close-all", then a `halt`
event "close-all complete ...").
CloseAllResponse.title: CloseAllResponse

ComponentBuild.description:
One process's code identity (contracts.build). `build` None: unknown
(the process never recorded one: not started, or started on older code).
ComponentBuild.title: ComponentBuild

EngineEvent.description: One line of the engine's append-only event log (data/events.jsonl).
EngineEvent.title: EngineEvent

EntryContext.description: Market state at one entry, from candles. All deterministic.
EntryContext.title: EntryContext

ExposureMode.description:
How an `allocation` wallet turns the invested dollars into exposure.
match:  his book at his own leverage. Copy notional = his notional / his equity x allocation_usd.
target: his book at YOUR leverage. Copy notional = his notional / his gross notional
        x allocation_usd x target_leverage, i.e. allocation x L spread in his proportions.
ExposureMode.title: ExposureMode

FundingLimits.description: Live maxima per action (USD), read from Hyperliquid at request time.
FundingLimits.title: FundingLimits

ImportEnvStatus.description: GET /api/accounts/import-env: whether the one-click migration applies.
ImportEnvStatus.title: ImportEnvStatus

LeaderOverride.description: Per-leader override. Absent field = inherit the book-wide value.
LeaderOverride.title: LeaderOverride

McpPendingPlan.description:
v11: one live (unused, unexpired) MCP plan as the web's "Pending MCP plans" panel
shows it, WITH its confirm code. Served only to the admin token.
McpPendingPlan.title: McpPendingPlan

RefreshAgentRequest.description:
For `created` accounts: passphrase unlocks the main key to sign a new approveAgent.
For connected accounts the web runs prepare/submit again instead.
RefreshAgentRequest.title: RefreshAgentRequest

Settings.description:
The whole user-editable configuration. Stored at data/settings.json,
owned by the api service (the only writer), read by the engine every cycle.
Settings.title: Settings

SettingsPatch.description:
Partial Settings for PATCH /api/settings.

Every field is Optional and "unset" (not just None) means "leave as
is" -- SettingsStore.patch() checks `model_fields_set`, not `is None`,
for every field except leader_overrides, where None is the documented
"clear this leader's override" sentinel.

Range constraints (ge/le, max_length) are intentionally NOT duplicated
here. contracts.models.Settings is the single source of truth for
valid ranges; SettingsStore.patch() re-validates the merged result
through it before writing, which still 422s a bad value, just one
layer later, with the file-untouched guarantee coming from
validate-then-write ordering in SettingsStore.patch().
SettingsPatch.title: SettingsPatch

SmallAccountMode.description:
What to do when a copy slice is under HL's $10.50 minimum (small allocations).
concentrate: copy only the positions that clear the minimum and spread the whole
             allocation across those, in the leader's proportions (his biggest bets).
bump:        round a small slice up to the minimum while it fits the allocation cap.
skip:        drop slices under the minimum.
SmallAccountMode.title: SmallAccountMode

Thesis.description:
A written strategy thesis for one trader. `ta` ones are regenerated
from the fingerprint; `claude_code` ones are saved through the MCP
server and kept until replaced.
Thesis.title: Thesis

ThesisWrite.description:
PUT /api/scout/traders/{address}/thesis. The server sets `source`
("claude_code", always), `address` and `created_ms`; a body carrying
any of them is a 422 (extra="forbid"), so a client can never write a
"ta" thesis.
ThesisWrite.title: ThesisWrite

TradeDirection.description:
copy: mirror his positions. counter: take the opposite side of every position he opens
(he goes long, we go short), same size rules; reduces and closes follow his, inverted.
TradeDirection.title: TradeDirection

TradeExample.description: One representative round trip shown as evidence for a fingerprint claim.
TradeExample.title: TradeExample

TraderScore.description:
One ranked candidate. Ranked by what COPYING him would have earned at
the given settings, not by his own PnL.
TraderScore.title: TraderScore

TradingAccount.description: One trading account. Never carries a secret.
TradingAccount.title: TradingAccount

TransferRequest.description: usdSend between copycat-created accounts (the source's main key signs).
TransferRequest.title: TransferRequest

UserActionPrepareRequest.description: Browser path, step 1: the api builds the exact action + EIP-712 typed data.
UserActionPrepareRequest.title: UserActionPrepareRequest

UserActionRunRequest.description: Passphrase path (created accounts): the vault signs with the main key.
UserActionRunRequest.title: UserActionRunRequest

UserActionSubmitRequest.description:
Browser path, step 2: the signed action. The api re-checks every guard,
recovers the signer (must be the account's address) and posts it.
UserActionSubmitRequest.title: UserActionSubmitRequest

WalletCopyRequest.description:
POST /api/wallets/{address}/copy: add the wallet to the book (if new)
and set its allocation in one atomic settings write.
WalletCopyRequest.title: WalletCopyRequest

WalletPosition.description:
GET /api/wallets: one row per wallet the user is invested in (in the
book) or still winding down (an orphan with open copies, or stopping).
The LeaderStatus "position" fields plus the allocation terms.
WalletPosition.title: WalletPosition

WalletPreview.description:
POST /api/wallets/{address}/preview: what investing would copy of his
book right now. Computed by engine.sizing.plan_allocation, the same
function the engine sizes with.
WalletPreview.title: WalletPreview

WalletPreviewSlice.description: One of his positions in a WalletPreview.
WalletPreviewSlice.title: WalletPreviewSlice

WalletProjection.description:
GET /api/wallets/{a}/projection: his last 30d replayed onto `allocation_usd`
at the given terms (inverted for counter). From cached data, no orders.
WalletProjection.title: WalletProjection

WalletStopRequest.description:
POST /api/wallets/{address}/stop. close_positions true: close our copies
of this wallet now (reduce-only, like close-all for one wallet). False: stop
opening new copies and let the open ones follow him out.
WalletStopRequest.title: WalletStopRequest

WalletStopResponse.description:
POST /api/wallets/{address}/stop. `settings` no longer has the wallet.
`stopping` true: a stop-and-close is pending; the engine closes the copies
on its next cycles (events: `close` reason "stop wallet", then `skip`
"wallet stopped") and `GET /api/wallets` shows the row winding down.
WalletStopResponse.title: WalletStopResponse

delete.description:
Audit H6/M11: same guard as activate. Deleting an account drops its agent key, so
any copy still open on it (active or not) could never be followed or closed again.
The vault clears active_id when the active one goes: the engine goes idle.

schema.title: Response Remove Api Accounts  Account Id  Delete

post.description:
Emergency flatten. Flips `enabled` false FIRST (so nothing new opens
even before the engine sees the flag), then writes
`data/close_all.flag`. The engine's next cycle closes every copy it
opened, reduce-only, regardless of `dry_run`; positions copycat did not
open are never touched. Idempotent: a second call while one is pending
just refreshes the timestamp.

schema.title: Response Get Events Api Events Get

get.description:
OHLCV bars in [start_ms, end_ms], oldest first, at most 5000 bars.
Bad interval, end <= start, or a range over the cap is 422.

schema.title: Response Get Candles Api Market Candles Get

post.description:
Build a copy plan for `address` at `amount_usd`: the engine's own
preview at these custom terms, the cached 30-day projection if any, and
the warnings to read before approving. Read-only on the book: stored
for MCP_PLAN_TTL_S, used once by execute. 502/503 when the live preview
fails. The response never carries the confirm code (audit H2): the human
reads it in the web (GET /api/mcp/plans/pending) or a notification.

get.description:
Live plans (unused, unexpired), newest first, WITH their confirm codes, so the
human can read the code in copycat and type it to Claude. Admin token only.

schema.title: Response Pending Plans Api Mcp Plans Pending Get

post.description:
Apply a plan: guards (a)-(f) in api.mcp_plans, then the plan's custom
terms through the Trade page's copy write. Never changes `enabled` or
`dry_run`; with trading off nothing is ordered.

403.description: disabled, wrong confirm code, or over a cap

409.description: his book changed, or your book is full

404.description: not a 0x address, or no data for it

Latest thesis per source, "ta" first then "claude_code". Empty list
when none exist. Never computes: the "ta" one is refreshed by each
fingerprint compute.

schema.title: Response Get Thesis Api Scout Traders  Address  Thesis Get

put.description:
Saves a "claude_code" thesis (the copycat MCP server's write path).
`source`, `address`, `created_ms` are server-set; `fingerprint_as_of_ms`
links it to the cached 30d fingerprint when there is one.

get.description:
Representative round trips WITH entry context (`TradeExample`), the
evidence behind the 30d fingerprint's claims (largest win, typical
breakout entry, ...). TradeExample, not RoundTrip, because the entry
context is the point for a thesis; the full RoundTrip list (no context)
is `TraderProfile.recent_trips`. Same 202 while the fingerprint builds.

schema.title: Response Get Trades Api Scout Traders  Address  Trades Get

202.description: fingerprint is being computed; poll again

502.description: the fingerprint compute failed (next GET retries)

post.description:
Sim of this one wallet at the CURRENT settings file merged with
`body.override`, on cached fills and candles only. One at a time per api
process: a second request while one runs is 409, never queued (a queue
of sims would just pile up threadpool workers).

404.description: not a 0x address, or no data for it

get.description:
One row per wallet in the book (settings order), then every wallet
out of the book: winding down (an orphan with open copies, or a stop
still pending) or stopped with a PnL history (a ledger row) and not
archived yet. `include=archived` also returns archived wallets (from the
ledger: realized PnL and their last terms). Position fields come from the
engine's last cycle; if the engine package is missing the book rows still
come back, zeroed, read_ok false. ROE % = (realized + unrealized) /
allocation_usd x 100, None for a wallet not on allocation sizing. Terms:
in-book wallets from settings; out-of-book ones from the engine's
`effective` (the terms they last ran with). `style` is his Scout style
when Scout has his board row, else null.

schema.title: Response List Wallets Api Wallets Get

post.description:
Archive a stopped wallet: out of the book, no stop pending, no copies.
It leaves GET /api/wallets (see `?include=archived`) and the engine stops
reading it. Copying it again un-archives it (a fresh investment). 409
otherwise; 503 when the engine package is missing.

409.description: still in the book, stopping, or holding copies

post.description:
Copy this wallet. `settings_source` global: it runs on the Settings
tab (its override is cleared to bookkeeping only). custom: invest
`allocation_usd` with its own terms, or adjust them. `invested_ms` is set
when the wallet is added and kept on a re-post, so its PnL ledger carries
on. 409 at MAX_LEADERS, 400 for a bad address or our own account, 422
for custom without `allocation_usd` or target exposure without
`target_leverage`. A pending stop for the wallet is cancelled: the newer
command wins.

get.description:
This wallet's engine events, newest first: opens/adds/reduces/closes
and skips with their reason ("paused", "filtered: BTC", "worse than
entry"...). Page with `before_ms` = the last row's ts_ms. Read from the
tail of events.jsonl with a capped scan, so an old wallet in a big log
may return fewer rows than exist. 503 when the engine package is missing.

schema.title: Response Wallet Events Api Wallets  Address  Events Get

post.description:
Pause one wallet: the engine opens and adds nothing for it (skip
"paused"); its open copies still follow his reduces and closes. Pausing
is not stopping: the wallet stays in the book. A global wallet gets a
minimal override `{paused: true}` and stays "global". 404 when the wallet
is not in the book.

What investing would copy of his book right now, sized by the same
`engine.sizing.plan_allocation` the engine uses. 502 when his live read
fails, 503 when the engine package is missing.

get.description:
His last 30d replayed onto `allocation_usd` at these terms (counter =
every side inverted, liquidations on our side), by discovery's copy-sim
on CACHED fills and candles only: no HL call in this request. Unset terms
come from the wallet's current settings (custom override, else the
Settings tab), and his coin filters apply. No cached data for him yet:
202 with the Scout status, and a build is queued (as GET
/api/scout/traders/{a} does). 409 while another what-if runs.

202.description: no cached data yet; a build is queued

post.description:
Resume a paused wallet. Moves he made while paused are not entered
midway; the next position he opens is copied. 404 when not in the book.

Stop copying this wallet: remove it (and its override) from settings,
then write `data/stop/<address>.flag`. 404 when it is neither in the book
nor an orphan we still hold copies of; 503 if that cannot be checked
because the engine package is missing.
